description: This file defines the MessageDeserializer class responsible for deserializing Message objects from JSON representations, including handling message headers and payload according to content type.

classes.name: MessageDeserializer
classes.description: Utility class for deserializing Message objects from JSON, providing static methods for different deserialization strategies and content type checking.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a Message object from its JSON string representation, extracting headers and payload.

methods.name: deserializeMessageFromHeadersAndPayload
methods.description: Constructs a Message from provided headers and payload, using a MessageBuilder.

methods.name: shouldBeInterpretedAsTextOrJson
methods.description: Determines whether a given ContentType indicates that the message payload should be interpreted as text or JSON.
